label: View
description: A saved list of items, held here and shared by every app: which items, in what order and how they group. How an app shows them is the app's own. Written only through `/views`: created, changed at a version, and deleted, which removes it at once with no trash. Lifecycle bounded to active | revoked. Has no tier.

query.description: Which items the view lists. `types`: type identifiers, each with its subtypes; empty or absent lists every type the reading key reads. `tier`: `library`, `feed` or `all`; absent is `all`. `state`: `active`, `archived` or both; absent is both. `filter`: an expression in the listing grammar's `filter`. `beneath`: an item id; the item and everything under it by `parent-of`.

sort.description: The keys the view sorts by, first key first. Each is a `by` field and a `direction`, `asc` or `desc`.

group.description: How the view groups the items it lists: `by` (a field, or `edge[<type>]` or `backref[<type>]`), and optionally `bucket` (`day`, `week`, `month` or `year`, for a date field), `order` (the values whose groups come first) and `hidden` (the values whose groups are left out).
